title: Fixed quotient bases in a strict henselization
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local commutative ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], with maximal ideal n and residue field k. Let K be a separable closure of k and C an A-algebra which is its strict henselization [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization]. There exist a set X, elements x_i of C for i in X, and for every positive integer r an A-linear isomorphism e_r from the finitely supported functions X to A/n^r onto C/(nC)^r, such that e_r sends the function supported at i with value 1 to the class of x_i. No completion comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 07QM (lemma-dumb-properties-henselization), part (4), using Algebra Tags 00HI and 051F

proof.text: Apply IsStrictHenselization.triples_presentation to the given hC. This supplies a residue-triples cocone with vertex C and exactly the original structural A-map. Apply strictHenselization_faithfullyFlat to this cocone, then RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff to get Module.Flat A C. Only flatness, not an identification of C/nC with K, is needed.

The canonical quotient C/nC is an A/n-vector space, so choose a basis with Module.Free.chooseBasis. Lift each vector using the surjectivity of C -> C/nC. This gives one index type X : Type u and one family x : X -> C, independent of r.

For each r >= 1 apply the generic flat-algebra power-basis lemma to the chosen residue basis and its fixed lifts. Choose the bases of C/(n^r C) it supplies. Invert each basis representation and restrict its scalars from A/n^r to A. Compose with Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq using Ideal.map_pow to replace n^r C by (nC)^r. Basis.repr_symm_single_one and the value property of each chosen basis give exactly the requested standard-generator equation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07QM(4), proof; simplified by choosing a basis directly in C/nC instead of identifying it with K. The quotient-basis lifting is fully formalized using Tag 051F and flat base change.

lean.statement:
theorem strictHenselization_quotient_bases
    (A K C : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra A K] [IsScalarTower A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra A C] (hC : IsStrictHenselization A K C) :
    ∃ (X : Type u) (x : X → C)
      (e : ∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r →
        (X →₀ A ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ^ r) ≃ₗ[A]
          C ⧸ ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)) ^ r),
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (i : X),
        e r hr (Finsupp.single i 1) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A C)) ^ r)
            (x i))
